constraints: do not project 2370s political alignment backwards or forwards automatically
crew_generation: Cardassian military staffing derived from actual mission/watch requirements
persistence: individual ship survives operator/political changes unless destroyed/captured
ai_boundary: Class does not imply crew loyalty, cruelty, Dominion alignment or intelligence mission.
visual_hooks: Cardassian ochre/gold hull grammar and recognizable Galor planform

constraints: cloaking/enhanced Obsidian Order examples are special configurations, not universal class baseline
crew_generation: mission/operator determines intelligence specialists or special crews
persistence: special covert configuration belongs to individual/configuration state
ai_boundary: Do not assume every Keldon is Obsidian Order or cloaked.

constraints: small platform; do not upscale into Galor-equivalent capability
crew_generation: very small crew makes named occupants likely to become persistent quickly
persistence: small craft remains same entity through assignment/operator changes
ai_boundary: Visual recognition as Cardassian does not reveal crew mission or allegiance.
visual_hooks: small Cardassian hull grammar distinct from Galor/Keldon

generation_rules: No Pike/Kirk-era Cardassian military class generation is added without sources.
Union, intelligence-service, resistance or Dominion operator state is temporal and explicit.
Individual vessels can be captured, defect or change operator without changing physical identity.
unknown_policy: Exact performance, crew and internal layout remain conservative unless sourced.
nap_implications: Cardassian visual identity resolves design class before operator markings, campaign damage and political-state overlays.
